---
title: "GDrive Uploads"
---



> This guide will help us maintain a standardized structure and naming convention within our shared Google Drive directory.

> Follow the **Florida Keys** example below for example.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 📂 [NCRMP - All Participant]{.dir} {.tabset}

This is the top-level directory given to all partners with each region having its own directory

###  {.unnumbered}

### 📂 [Florida Keys]{.dir} {.tabset}

::::::::: nested
This directory contains data specific to the Florida Keys.  Each 'Boatlog Manager' or Project will have its own directory

####  {.unnumbered}

#### 📂 [NOAA SEFSC]{.dir} {.tabset}

:::::::: nested
This directory contains data collected by NOAA SEFSC.

#####  {.unnumbered}

##### 📂 [GPS Logs]{.dir}

::: nested-2
-   **Purpose**: Stores GPS logs from fieldwork.
:::

##### 📂 [Scanned Datasheets]{.dir} {.tabset}

::::: nested-4
This directory contains scanned paper datasheets.

######  {.unnumbered}

###### 📂 [Boatlogs]{.dir}

::: nested-4
-   **Purpose**: Stores boat log sheets.

``` bash
📂 Boatlogs/
    ├── SEFSC_Boatlogs_1.pdf
    ├── SEFSC_Boatlogs_2.pdf
```
:::

###### 📂 [Diver Scans]{.dir}

::: nested-3
-   **Purpose**: Stores diver data sheets.

``` bash
📂 Diver Scans/
    ├── Blondeau_fish.pdf
    ├── Blondeau_LPI.pdf
    ├── Blondeau_demo.pdf
```
:::
:::::

##### 📂 [Site Photos]{.dir}

::: nested-2
-   **Purpose**: Stores habitat from survey sites.

``` bash
📂 Site Photos/
    ├── 📂 1001_fish
    ├── 📂 1001_benthic
    ├── 📂 1245_fish
    ├── 📂 1350_fish
```
:::
::::::::
:::::::::

> Please follow the NOAA SEFSC for full example
